prompt: Records nest, so they can model a tree: add up the sizes, count the files, and measure the depth of a folder that contains files and more folders. Complete FolderTree with recursion.
explanation: A record component can be a list of the very record type being declared, which is all you need to describe a tree. Each method handles the local level with a loop and then calls itself on each sub-folder, so the recursion stops naturally at folders whose subfolders list is empty. depth() differs from the other two because it takes the maximum of the children rather than the sum, and adds 1 for the current level.
hints: Each method has the same shape: handle this folder's own files first, then loop over subfolders and call the same method on each one.
The base case needs no special if: an empty subfolders list simply means the loop body never runs.
For depth(), track the biggest child depth with Math.max inside the loop and return 1 + that value.
